component.name: PhoneMic
component.summary: Use your phone as a microphone for your PC

description.p: Speak into your phone and it shows up as a microphone ("PhoneMic Microphone") in Discord, Zoom, OBS, Teams or any other app. The phone connects over Bluetooth, Wi-Fi or a USB cable, with no extra drivers.

ul.li: Low latency, with drift compensation and packet-loss concealment
Opus compression with forward error correction
Noise removal (RNNoise), voice effects, gain and mute
